hooks.command: { [ "$BETTER_CC_TELEGRAM" = 1 ] || [ -f "${TELEGRAM_STATE_DIR:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/channels/telegram}/bot.pid" ]; } && { b=; for c in "$BETTER_CC_TELEGRAM_BIN" "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/better-claude-code-telegram/bin/bcct" bcct; do [ -n "$c" ] || continue; v=$("$c" --version </dev/null) || continue; case "$v" in "bcct "*) b=$c; break ;; esac; done; if [ -n "$b" ]; then "$b" hook permission; else node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/telegram.mjs" permission; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
